Looking at the first fold: the strip makes angle α = 63° with the fold line AB. Reflecting the upper part across AB turns the strip's direction from 63° above horizontal to 63° below horizontal, so the two layers of the strip form an angle of 180° − 2α = 180° − 126° = 54° at the top.

The second fold merely reflects one layer of the strip across a line along the other layer's edge; reflection preserves the angle between the layers. Hence the angle β between the two visible parts of the strip in the final figure equals the angle formed after the first fold:

β = 180° − 2α = 180° − 126° = 54°.

\boxed{D}
